source.listing_description:
Experience effortless commuting with the MileCity 1 Electric Bike featuring a powerful 250W motor and a 36V 13Ah removable battery delivering up to 100 km (62 miles) per charge.

This electric bike solves the need for a reliable, eco-friendly transportation option suitable for urban environments by combining durability, long battery life, and smooth gear shifting in a stylish, step-through ergonomic frame.

Key Features

  • Long Range: Enjoy up to 100 km (62 miles) on a single charge via the 36V 13Ah removable battery.
  • Powerful Motor: 250W motor providing 42 Nm torque for smooth acceleration and climbing.
  • Seven-Speed Gear System: 7-speed Shimano shifter for easy adjustment to various terrains and speeds.
  • Durable Build: High-carbon steel step-through frame offering stability, safety, and comfort.
  • Efficient Braking & Suspension: Front suspension fork and disc brakes for optimal safety and shock absorption.

Specifications

  • Wheel Size: 26 inches (66 cm)
  • Total Length: 168.5 cm (66.33 in)
  • Wheelbase: 102.7 cm (40.43 in)
  • Max Handlebar Height: 98 cm (38.58 in)
  • Min Handlebar Height: 96 cm (37.79 in)
  • Max Seat Height: 97 cm (38.18 in)
  • Min Seat Height: 77 cm (30.31 in)
  • Standover Height: 44 cm (17.32 in)
  • Reach: 62.5 cm (24.6 in)
  • Bike Weight: 26.85 kg (59.1 lbs)
  • Max Load Capacity: 120 kg (265 lbs)
  • Speed: Up to 25 km/h (15.5 mph)
  • Water Resistance: IP65 waterproof rating
  • Display: Colorful LED LCD
  • Material: High-carbon steel frame, alloy components
  • Color: Mint green with black accents
